Definition: from G5590; sensitive, i.e. animate (in distinction on the one hand from G4152, which is the higher or renovated nature; and on the other from G5446, which is the lower or bestial nature):--natural, sensual.
BiblicalUsage: Psychikos means natural, soulish, belonging to the soul rather than the Spirit. Paul says the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God, for they are foolishness unto him, neither can he know them, because they are spiritually discerned. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body, and the first is natural and afterward that which is spiritual. James says the wisdom that descends not from above is earthly, sensual, devilish.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the natural man is not the bad man but the man without the Spirit: he can be clever and moral and still not receive the things of God, because they are spiritually discerned. I hold that the change I need is not improvement but resurrection, from a natural body to a spiritual one, and from earthly wisdom to wisdom from above.
